extension.name: e-Invoice Print
extension.description: Print a completed invoice as an e-invoice copy, with the QR code, IRN, Ack No. and Ack Date repeated at the top of every page. Details are read from the e-invoice Zoho Books already filed against the invoice — nothing to set up.

status.loading: Reading e-invoice details from Zoho Books…
status.ready: e-Invoice details loaded from Zoho Books. Ready to print.
status.no_einvoice: Zoho Books has no e-invoice record for this invoice.
status.no_qr: IRN found, but Books returned no QR for this e-invoice.
status.qr_linked: Ready. The QR is linked from Zoho Books rather than embedded.
status.popup_blocked: Your browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-ups for Zoho Books and try again.
